_meta.description: Curated mapping from catalog row IDs (data/landscape.json, section 'Foundation models (substrate reference)') to Chatbot Arena (LMArena / arena.ai) model identifiers, per docs/composite-methodology.md §8.2. Consumed by scripts/arena_crosscheck.py. JSON has no comments, so this _meta block documents the schema.

schema.mappings: object keyed by landscape.json row id -> {arena_model, arena_elo, matched_on, note}. arena_model is the LMArena leaderboard identifier of the best-ranked model that falls WITHIN the family named by the catalog row (variant-fidelity rule: never map a row to a newer generation than the row is scoped to). arena_elo is a point-in-time snapshot integer (see elo_snapshot).
schema.unmapped: object keyed by row id -> {rationale} for every foundation-model row that does NOT map. Non-foundation-model rows are out of scope and are not listed.
schema.elo_snapshot: provenance for the arena_elo values. The cross-check script never fetches the network at runtime (repo convention: network-free CI); Elo values are frozen here and refreshed by editing this file.

elo_snapshot.precision: band-approximate (±15 Elo). Values compiled from secondary snapshot mirrors of the Arena text leaderboard (June 2026 state), not from a live API pull. Top-tier ordering (Claude Opus 4.8 > GPT-5.5 Pro ≈ Gemini 3.1 Pro ≈ Claude Opus 4.7) and tier bands (1510+ / ~1500 / ~1450 / ~1300 / ~1200) are consistent across sources; exact third-digit Elo and bootstrap CIs were not reliably reported by the mirrors.

_meta.coverage_note: 13 foundation-model rows in landscape.json; 7 mapped, 6 unmapped. Partial coverage is expected per issue #131.

anthropic-claude-foundation-models--anth.note: Arena #1 overall, June 2026. Claude Opus 4.7 also listed in the ~1500 tier.

openai-gpt-family-gpt-5-gpt-4o-o3-o4--op.note: Arena #2 overall, June 2026; GPT-5.5 (non-Pro) also top-5. Row is scoped to the GPT family broadly, so 5.5 falls within scope.

google-gemini-3-family--blog-google.note: Gemini 3.1 is within the Gemini 3 family named by the row.

xai-grok-4--x-ai.note: Grok 4.20 climbed into the Arena top 5 in May 2026 (+31 Elo); grok-4 also remains listed in the top 10. 4.20 is a point release within the Grok 4 family.

alibaba-qwen-3-family--qwenlm-github-io.note: Qwen 3.7 Max sits in the ~1450 tier; 3.7 is a point release within the Qwen 3 family named by the row.

meta-llama-4-family--ai-meta-com.note: Best-ranked Llama 4 variant on the June 2026 board (~1300 tier).

microsoft-phi-4-family--azure-microsoft-.note: Listed in the ~1200 tier ('solid daily' band), June 2026.

deepseek-r1-v3-family--deepseek-com.rationale: Generation mismatch (variant-fidelity rule): the catalog row is scoped to the R1 / V3 generation, but Arena's June 2026 board headlines DeepSeek V4 / V4.1 Pro — a newer generation. R1/V3 entries have dropped out of the reliably-reported portion of secondary snapshots, so no trustworthy 2026 Elo exists for the row's own generation. Mapping V4.x Elo to an R1/V3 composite would compare different models.

mistral-large-2-mixtral-family--mistral-.rationale: Generation mismatch: Arena's June 2026 board lists Mistral Large 3 (~1300 tier) and Mistral Small 3 (~1200 tier); the catalog row is scoped to Large 2 / Mixtral, which no longer appear in reported snapshots.

cohere-command-r-command-a--cohere-com.rationale: No reliable 2026 Elo found: Command A / Command R+ do not appear in any of the June 2026 secondary snapshot sources consulted. Historically listed on Arena (Command A ~1360, March 2025), but a stale Elo would not be comparable to the 2026 snapshot used for the other rows.

amazon-nova-family--aboutamazon-com.rationale: Not reported in 2026 snapshot sources: no Nova entry (Premier/Pro/Lite) appears in the June 2026 leaderboard mirrors consulted.

reka-core-flash-edge--reka-ai.rationale: Not listed on Arena: Reka Core / Flash / Edge do not appear on the current (June 2026) leaderboard.

01-ai-yi-family--01-ai.rationale: Not listed on Arena: Yi family entries (Yi-Large, Yi-Lightning) no longer appear in current (June 2026) leaderboard snapshots.
